# Molecular dynamics trajectory metrics plot

Plots the standard summaries of a molecular dynamics simulation - RMSD
or radius of gyration over time, RMSF per residue, hydrogen-bond
counts - as one line per group (typically a replica or a series),
optionally smoothed with a running mean over the faded raw trace, and
optionally faceted into stacked panels (one per metric). It takes the
long data frame
[`read_xvg()`](https://j-andrews7.github.io/sciVizModules/reference/read_xvg.md)
returns, or any table with an x, a value and a grouping column (e.g.
MDAnalysis or mdtraj output saved as CSV).

## Usage

``` r
mdTrajectoryMetrics(
  df,
  x = "x",
  y = "value",
  group = "series",
  facet = NULL,
  smooth.window = 0,
  time.unit = "as is",
  length.unit = "as is",
  show.raw = TRUE,
  raw.opacity = 0.3,
  colors = NULL,
  main = NULL
)
```

## Arguments

- df:

  A data frame.

- x, y:

  Columns for the x-axis (time, frame or residue) and the value.

- group:

  Column whose levels get one line each, or `NULL`.

- facet:

  Column whose levels get one stacked panel each, or `NULL`.

- smooth.window:

  Width (in points) of the centred running mean; 0 or 1 for none.

- time.unit:

  `"as is"`, `"ps to ns"` or `"ns to ps"`, applied to the x values when
  their label names that unit.

- length.unit:

  `"as is"`, `"nm to A"` or `"A to nm"`, applied to the values when
  their label names that unit.

- show.raw:

  Logical; draw the raw trace under the smoothed one.

- raw.opacity:

  Opacity of the raw trace when smoothing.

- colors:

  Named vector of colours for the groups.

- main:

  Optional plot title.

## Value

A `plotly` object, with a summary table (per group and panel: points,
mean, SD, and the mean over the second half, a rough equilibrated value)
as attribute `"table"`.

## See also

[`read_xvg()`](https://j-andrews7.github.io/sciVizModules/reference/read_xvg.md),
[`mdTrajectoryMetricsServer()`](https://j-andrews7.github.io/sciVizModules/reference/mdTrajectoryMetricsServer.md)

## Author

Jared Andrews

## Examples

``` r
files <- system.file("extdata", sprintf("example_rmsd_rep%d.xvg.gz", 1:3),
    package = "sciVizModules")
rmsd <- do.call(rbind, Map(read_xvg, files, series = paste("replica", 1:3)))
mdTrajectoryMetrics(rmsd, smooth.window = 11, time.unit = "ps to ns")
```
